rig.title: Garbage In
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Big Frackin' Gun
rig.rulesText: [6]: Break up to five sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.
